snippet.title: The FATUM - Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by beloved classics like Papers Please & Observer with the brutalist world design of STALKER & Pathologic, The FATUM has you take control of an investigator charged with preventing the end of civilisation within the bunker to eliminate disease! 

The Supreme Committee congratulates you on your promotion. Your task is to identify citizens infected by the unknown virus. Interrogate, inspect, pass a verdict. Test your deduction in a world of total control. Remember: the Standard above all.
